name: fix-speaker-notes-placement
body: source: 'A `# notes` section holds speaker notes … allowed only on slides'; inconsistency: how many notes sections a slide may have, where they go, and whether they count toward section limits were undefined (feedback-5); resolution: at most one `# notes` per slide; it must be the last section; it does not count toward any section min/max; duplicates or non-last placement = error; `# notes` in a section template context stays an error — written into speaker-notes and the slide-parser component [with user]
